title: ꯂꯩꯐꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯆꯥꯑꯣꯊꯣꯛ | Birds Song Manipuri Kids Rhymes | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
A sweet and cheerful Manipuri nursery rhyme all about birds, perfect for little ones to sing along with.
Watch the birds sing, hop and fly across the sky with bubbly melodies.
A fun way for toddlers and preschoolers to learn about birds, families and happy songs.
